brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested three young men from Beit Ummar in the northern Hebron area on Wednesday, the Shehab Wire reported. The operation marked the latest in a series of military detentions across the West Bank.

The identities of the three detainees were not disclosed. Israeli forces have conducted frequent arrest operations in Palestinian towns and villages, particularly in areas surrounding Hebron, as part of broader security operations in the occupied territory. The circumstances surrounding Wednesday's arrests in Beit Ummar remained unclear as of reporting.
